sources.purpose: Public observer subscribe, options, and teardown contract
Public cache, initial data, invalidation, cancellation and clear APIs
Active release history, rechecked against exact registry publication timestamp
Repository advisory index; no SECURITY.md detected; listed advisory concerns a different package
2026-05-15 scope statement says Query was unaffected; document contains an inconsistent older timeline reference to query-core, retained as source uncertainty
Family documentation browser targets; core verified independently in actual browser matrix

browserTargets.sourceScope: React Query family documentation, not a separately guaranteed core support matrix

external.advisoryConclusion: npm audit reported zero known vulnerabilities for this exact isolated fixture. This is dated database evidence, not a guarantee of absence.

sensitivity.eligibilityAssumption: Hard-gate failures are excluded. Native also requires the separately inspected approval conditions. Server wins an eligible score gap below two points.

inspection.method: Separate static and lifecycle review in the same author session after initial common browser proof; findings recorded in ticket 0020 and followed by direct regressions. This is not a second-person review.

evidence.browser: e2e/resource-strategy.spec.ts: S01-S15 common driver; browserProof retains 87 successful focused executions and nine disposal reports. Delivery run 2026-09-05T20-32-56-549Z-4971 passed all 448 repository browser executions across eight profiles.
evidence.ownership: test/resource-strategy.test.ts: public conformance, failed installation, failed cleanup, final lease abort and release after disposal
evidence.server: test/resource-strategy-server.test.mjs: negotiated representations, ETags, CSRF, validation, version conflicts, native redirects, session isolation

inspection.modelAccounting: The identical common shell carries the SSR seed and HTML helper for all prototypes. Only JSON strategies retain subsequent project response models and call the client read renderer. That additional model is the authority rubric deduction.
inspection.maintenanceCadence: Quarterly ownership, package-release and advisory review; replay this experiment before changing the supported resource strategy.
inspection.maintenanceInterpretation: Planning estimates from the frozen formula, not measured labor. Concepts list the strategy-specific integration surface; delegated Query Core transitions are not counted as owned adapter transitions.

serverMaterialWorkflowGap.evidence: All fixed semantic, lifecycle, authority and accessibility flows pass with coordinated patches. WebKit warm revisits cost another origin read and about 89 ms under the 80 ms fixture delay; that is a real optimization opportunity, not a failed workflow requirement.

externalMateriallyUnsuitable.evidence: The 67-line adapter closes the warm-revisit gap with the public framework-neutral core, about 9 KiB incremental gzip, MIT licensing, no transitive runtime dependencies and no known exact-package audit findings.

nativeRobustAdvantage.evidence: Native is smaller but does not have the highest nominal full-rubric score. Weight and maintenance uncertainty must be reported; a small prototype is insufficient to justify a new stable native cache.
